claim_or_role: Two frozen historical-to-newer primary analyses and their >=15-kb denominators.
evidence_boundary: Both are retrospective reference-proxy analyses; newer assemblies are not absolute copy-number truth.

claim_or_role: Ey15-2 historical and newer assembly representation for all 19 eligible read-derived families.
evidence_boundary: Recovered-state labels use the newer-assembly reference proxy and do not independently validate biological collapse.

claim_or_role: Ey15-2 HiFi-to-historical deficit and newer-to-historical gain have Pearson r=0.589.
evidence_boundary: Magnitude agreement is descriptive and does not turn assembly gain into physical missing-base truth.

claim_or_role: Macadamia historical and newer assembly representation for all 43 eligible read-derived families.
evidence_boundary: The newer IPA assembly is a reference proxy; paper-level same-sample context does not establish same extraction.

claim_or_role: Macadamia HiFi-to-historical deficit and newer-to-historical gain have Pearson r=0.535.
evidence_boundary: Magnitude agreement is descriptive and does not establish absolute array copy number.

claim_or_role: All 8 Ey15-2 and 2 Macadamia preferentially recovered families were read-prioritized in the frozen primary analysis.
evidence_boundary: The 8/8 and 2/2 results are retrospective reference-proxy matches, not population accuracy estimates.
